name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) - Practice Pack 01
title: AWS CLF-C02 Practice Pack 01

questions.question: A company wants to launch an application without purchasing hardware upfront and wants to increase or decrease resources as demand changes. Which AWS Cloud benefit BEST addresses these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS provides economies of scale and elasticity. Customers can avoid large upfront hardware purchases and dynamically adjust resources as demand changes.

questions.question: A retail application experiences unpredictable traffic spikes during promotional events. Which AWS Cloud characteristic allows resources to automatically expand during spikes and shrink afterward?
questions.explanation: Elasticity is the ability to dynamically add or remove resources in response to changing demand.

questions.question: A company needs to grant an application running on Amazon EC2 temporary permissions to access an S3 bucket. Which solution follows AWS security best practices?
options: Store root user credentials on the instance
Create an IAM user and hard-code its access keys
Attach an IAM role to the EC2 instance
questions.explanation: An IAM role provides temporary credentials to EC2 workloads and avoids storing long-term access keys on the instance.

questions.question: A security team wants to identify potentially malicious activity such as unusual API calls and compromised EC2 credentials. Which AWS service is designed for this purpose?
questions.explanation: Amazon GuardDuty is a threat detection service. CloudTrail records API activity, while Inspector focuses on vulnerability management.

questions.question: A company needs automated vulnerability management for its Amazon EC2 instances and container images in Amazon ECR. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation: Amazon Inspector continuously scans supported workloads such as EC2 instances and ECR container images for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure.

questions.question: Which AWS service records actions taken by users, roles, and AWS services through API calls for governance and auditing?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudTrail records API activity and account events, helping with auditing, governance, compliance, and troubleshooting.

questions.question: A company stores sensitive documents in Amazon S3 and wants to automatically discover and classify personally identifiable information in those objects. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation: Amazon Macie uses machine learning and pattern matching to discover and help protect sensitive data stored in Amazon S3.

questions.question: A company needs a managed relational database compatible with MySQL and wants AWS to handle backups, patching, and routine database administration. Which service is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service. RDS for MySQL provides MySQL compatibility while AWS handles common administrative tasks.

questions.question: A company needs a highly scalable NoSQL key-value database for an application with single-digit millisecond performance requirements. Which service should it choose?
questions.explanation: Amazon DynamoDB is a serverless NoSQL key-value and document database designed for high scalability and low-latency performance.

questions.question: A company wants to run code in response to events without provisioning or managing servers. Which AWS service provides this capability?
questions.explanation: AWS Lambda is a serverless compute service that runs code in response to events without requiring customers to provision or manage servers.

questions.question: A company wants users around the world to download static website content with lower latency by caching copies near users. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation: Amazon CloudFront is AWS's content delivery network. It caches content at edge locations closer to users to reduce latency.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides object storage and is commonly used for backups, static website assets, data lakes, and archival workflows?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 is scalable object storage used for backups, static assets, data lakes, and archival workflows.

questions.question: An application requires a shared, managed file system that multiple Linux EC2 instances can mount concurrently. Which service is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: Amazon EFS provides managed elastic file storage that multiple Linux EC2 instances can mount concurrently.

questions.question: A company needs private dedicated network connectivity from its on-premises data center to AWS and wants more consistent network performance than an internet-based connection. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation: AWS Direct Connect provides dedicated private connectivity between a customer's environment and AWS.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides DNS registration, DNS routing, and health checking capabilities?
questions.explanation: Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable DNS service supporting domain registration, DNS routing, and health checking.

questions.question: A fault-tolerant batch-processing workload can tolerate interruptions and has flexible start and end times. Which Amazon EC2 purchasing option is generally the MOST cost-effective?
questions.explanation: Spot Instances use spare EC2 capacity at substantial discounts and suit flexible, fault-tolerant workloads that can handle interruption.

questions.question: A finance team wants to visualize historical AWS costs and usage and analyze spending trends. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation: AWS Cost Explorer provides tools to visualize, understand, and analyze AWS costs and usage over time.

questions.question: A company wants an alert when its AWS spending exceeds a predefined monthly threshold. Which service is MOST appropriate?
questions.explanation: AWS Budgets lets customers define cost or usage budgets and receive alerts when actual or forecasted values cross configured thresholds.

questions.question: An organization has multiple AWS accounts and wants to centrally manage them while receiving a combined bill. Which AWS service provides these capabilities?
questions.explanation: AWS Organizations helps centrally manage multiple AWS accounts and supports consolidated billing.

questions.question: A company deploys an application across multiple Availability Zones so that it can continue operating if infrastructure in one location fails. Which cloud design principle does this MOST directly improve?
questions.explanation: Deploying workloads across multiple Availability Zones reduces dependency on a single location and improves availability and resilience.
